validated_objective: Release QIF v0.8.6 with a frozen-scope rollout preview that evaluates every in-scope portable item, reconciles an affected-knowledge census, and forces governance before activation when coverage or outcomes are unsafe.
scope: qif-ledger rollout preview policy, item result, and census entities
deterministic verifier, negative fixtures, docs, portable package, roadmap, AOF evidence, and release
constraints: provider-neutral with no UI, live registry, live cryptography, sampling-as-completeness, or history mutation
no automatic activation, enforcement, authorization, authority, or semantic truth
expected_outcomes: every frozen in-scope item is represented exactly once and census arithmetic reconciles
material changes, unresolved inputs, duplicates, omissions, or stale scope route to governance
